# `tfctl harness`

The `tfctl harness` command group provides subcommands for managing AI agent harness installations.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl harness` command group provides subcommands for managing AI agent harness installations. A harness is the integration layer that enables AI coding agents to use tfctl effectively, including skills, context documentation, and permission controls. Use these commands to install AI agent skills and display agent context.

## Subcommands

- [`context`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/context) - Display harness context information
- [`exec`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/exec) - Run a child command with session-scoped delete permissions
- [`install`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/install) - Install harness components
